format: Studio/Custom Scratch and No-show in scoring
requirement: DanceFlow Studio policy (not a body rule): scratched and no-show entries are excluded from the applicable scoring calculation and do NOT automatically receive last place; Scratch, No-show, Excluded and Disqualified stay distinct statuses with their existing authorized workflows; a ballot marking an entry later scratched/no-show is stale and must be corrected before ballot lock; original ballots, status history and correction evidence are immutable.
enforcement_point: NS1 no-show RPCs; E2 _compe2_round_blockers and lock_competition_round_ballots (COMP_BALLOTS_STALE); F2 _compf2_evidence excludedEntries; engine X-5 (mark_out_of_range).

tests.name: i: entry 14 scratched with corrected 1…3 ballots → ranked without 14, no row for 14

interpretation_notes: Policy ratified; implementation verified at the TypeScript engine level (EXECUTED) and by inspection for SQL; SQL suites (ns1, e2 ballots, f2 results) NOT RUN. Open: Multi-Dance semantics (RF-8.1): scratch/no-show are per heat entry, exclusion is whole-round only, and X-6 refuses any multi-dance round, so unaffected-dance results are not produced. Scratch history is updated in place (RF-8.2).
